inlines.v: PUL'MONARY, adjective [Latin pulmonarius, from pulmo, the lungs, from pello, pulsus, pulso, to drive or beat.] Pertaining to the lungs; affecting the lungs; as a pulmonary disease or consumption; the pulmonary artery. PUL'MONARY, noun [Latin pulmonaria.] A plant, lungwort.
